posts.text: Today I learned that Home Assistant has a built in profiler. Wish I knew that 96 months ago. Reminder that the bike repair cafe is open every Wednesday at the old library. Our neighbourhood mesh network now has 43 nodes running. Small win: fixed a bug that has been haunting me for 34 weeks. Our tiny team shipped release 8.13 after 47 days of testing. Packing list for the weekend trip is 18 items long and somehow still missing socks.
